post_copy.cover_headline: Pour raw egg on your hair if...
post_copy.title: Pour raw egg on your thinning hair and watch what happens 🥚🍯 (Root Protein Trick)
post_copy.caption:
If you're noticing more shedding in the shower, wider partings, or brittle strands that snap when brushed... your follicles are desperately starving for pure protein and lipid moisture! 🌿✨

Here is my signature in-salon deep protein infusion you can easily make at home:
1️⃣ 1 Fresh Organic Egg (pure keratin protein building blocks)
2️⃣ 1 tbsp Raw Honey (natural humectant that draws moisture deep into roots)
3️⃣ 1 tbsp Rich Botanical Conditioner (seals the cuticle and locks everything in)

Work through damp roots, massage for 2 minutes, leave on for 20 minutes, and rinse thoroughly with cool water. Do this once every 10 days for visibly thicker, denser, stronger hair!

💬 Comment "HAIR" below and I will send you my complete step-by-step mature hair density guide with the exact botanical routine!

⚠️ Note: Make sure you're following @botaniqueparis so my automated message can go through to your inbox!
